name: mod-architect-challenges
about: mods/architect challenges: the seven HoH1 bad-wish challenges load as free architect alterations; their discounts multiply the vanilla cost curve and stop at a free run (0%, never below). Picked for a run (hwp architect try, the loadout Play's effect), the generation ones reach the floor (Crowded Halls + Champions set on the enemy placer) and the picks are on the player record. Then no script errors in our files.
